## R: Distribución Binomial

<div class="block-note mb-12">
<div class="block-body text-justify" style="font-size: 26px;">
En un lote de $n=50$ animales del hato, con $p=0.15$ de tener mastitis. Calcule $P(X=8)$, $P(X \leq 10)$, $P(X > 12)$, $P(X \geq 12)$ y $P(5 \leq X \leq 12)$.
</div>
</div>

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: start;">

<div class="scrollable-code" style="min-width: 0; max-height: 500px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: auto;">

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| comment: ""
#| class-source: scrollable-code

n <- 50; p <- 0.15

# Exactamente 8 animales
dbinom(8, n, p)

# Menor o igual que 10
pbinom(10, n, p)

# Estrictamente menor que 10
pbinom(9, n, p)

# Mayor que 12
pbinom(12, n, p, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Mayor o igual que 12
pbinom(11, n, p,lower.tail = FALSE)

# Entre 5 y 12 (inclusive)
pbinom(12, n, p) - pbinom(4, n, p)

```

</div>

<div class="card card--info" style="font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.9;">
<strong><code>dbinom(x, n, p): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X = x)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pbinom(q, n, p):</code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X \leq q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pbinom(q-1, n, p): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X < q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>lower.tail = FALSE: </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X > q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pbinom(q-1,...,FALSE): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X \geq q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>pbinom(b) - pbinom(a-1): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(a \leq X \leq b)$</span>
</div>

</div>
